name: LT - Emerald Intro Backfill Tagger (Staged)
description: Backfill tagger with offset paging and release-log checkpointing (backfill_checked).

parameters.query:
SELECT
  NULLIF(TRIM(r.ghl_contact_id), '') AS ghl_contact_id,
  LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(r.contact_email), '')) AS contact_email,
  MIN(r.release_ts) AS first_release_ts
FROM "Emerald_Release_Log" r
WHERE r.status = 'queued'
  AND r.release_ts <= CAST('{{$item(0).$node["Config"].json.legacyCutoffTs}}' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
  AND (
    NULLIF(TRIM(r.ghl_contact_id), '') IS NOT NULL
    OR NULLIF(TRIM(r.contact_email), '') IS NOT NULL
  )
GROUP BY NULLIF(TRIM(r.ghl_contact_id), ''), LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(r.contact_email), ''))
ORDER BY MIN(r.release_ts) ASC
LIMIT {{$item(0).$node["Config"].json.batchLimit}}
OFFSET {{$item(0).$node["Config"].json.batchOffset}};
